run_sample_evaluation: run the sample.py script to evaluate a trained inverse cooking model on a dataset split
run_perplexity_computation: run the sample.py script with get_perplexity flag to compute recipe generation perplexity scores
run_beam_search_sampling: run the sample.py script with beam search to generate ingredient and recipe predictions from food images
compute_score_function: compute the diversity score of sampled recipe token IDs by measuring unique token ratio
label2onehot_function: convert ingredient label tensors into one-hot encoded vectors for IoU comparison
